$comment: Image CVE exceptions (ADR-0015 item 4). Each entry: id, image (postgres|keycloak|redis|caddy|otelcollector, or the release images api|bff|migrator, #119), package, justification (20+ chars), issue (#n), added and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, expires at most 90 days after added). Matching is exact. A component on the request path of a LAN-reachable service (Caddy, Keycloak and its Java libraries, the BFF, the Api) needs Marco's recorded approval, a reachability argument and an expiry of at most 30 days; Caddy has no exception without it (#120, G3 S-120-07). See docs/runbooks/ci-security-gates.md.

exceptions.justification: No upstream fix released (fix state: unknown). Deployed context (#120, ADR-0016 R9, ADR-0018): Postgres is on the internal pg-app and pg-kc networks only, with no published port, SCRAM-authenticated roles, no capabilities and a read-only root filesystem; its only clients are the migrator, the Api and Keycloak. The server binary links zlib, so this rests on exposure, not on the library being unloaded. NEEDS CONFIRMATION from the Grype match path and the CVE vector (G3 S-120-07): acceptable only if the vector needs attacker-controlled compressed input that no client sends; if not, wait for a fixed digest. Not renewed past this expiry.

No upstream fix released (fix state: unknown). Deployed context (#120, ADR-0018 D5): Redis is on the internal cache network only and reachable only by the BFF, with no published port, the default ACL user off, no persistence, no capabilities and a read-only root filesystem. Redis is not believed to link zlib (G3 S-120-07). NEEDS CONFIRMATION from the Grype match location: if zlib is loaded, the exposure argument above is all there is and the entry is not renewed. Not renewed past this expiry.

No upstream fix released (fix state: not-fixed). Deployed context (#120, ADR-0018 D2): Keycloak is on the internal idp and pg-kc networks only; Caddy admits the LAN to the decisya realm paths and the workstation to the admin paths, and port 9000 is never routed. pcre2 is an OS package used by command-line tools such as grep; the JVM that serves HTTP is not believed to load it (G3 S-120-07). NEEDS CONFIRMATION from the Grype match path: unconfirmed means not renewed. Not renewed past this expiry.

Ubuntu rates it negligible and will not fix it (fix state: wont-fix); a denial of service in glibc crypt() SHA-crypt with very long keys, which the .NET apps never call. The Api is on the request path of a LAN-reachable service, so under G3's D-1 rule (S-120-07) Marco approved this exception on 2026-10-05 with a 30-day expiry; re-check at expiry or on the next base image bump.
